title: HomeMind push-to-talk request from the 7-inch UI to the perception node
description: NODE-RPI5-01 (UI button) to NODE-RPI5-02. start = begin listening for one utterance exactly like the local push-to-talk trigger; cancel = stop listening. Carries no audio and no text. The perception node ignores a request whose expires_at_ms has passed, so a press is never replayed after a reconnect. Core does not subscribe.
